title: Publications
claims: The NAIC publications catalog lists consumer titles including Consumer Guide to Title Insurance (TTL-CG), Consumer's Guide to Annuities (ANB-LP, ANB-LE, ANB-LS), Consumer's Guide to Auto Insurance (AUT-PP), Consumer's Guide to Cancer Insurance (CAX-PP), Consumer's Guide to Earthquake Insurance (EQU-PP), Consumer's Guide to Homeowners Insurance (HOI-PP), Consumer's Guide to Life Insurance (LIG-LP), Consumer's Guide to Long-Term Care Insurance (LTC-LP), and Consumer's Guide to Medigap (MED-LP).
The catalog title for the title insurance guide is Consumer Guide to Title Insurance, without an apostrophe-s, unlike the other consumer guide titles in the catalog.
The catalog contains a consumer guide to earthquake insurance.
The catalog page also points readers to an NAIC Library for archived publications.
updateCadence: Guides are reissued in new editions periodically.
